payload.body: You tend to pursue the sensible opportunity and then want to reject it before it changes how you live. Progress can feel managed by other people, while independence can leave an important skill or commitment undeveloped. This often comes from learning that advancement required compliance with someone else's definition of success. Keep the opportunity and renegotiate one expectation that makes it feel controlling.
payload.astroHint: Lilith opposite the North Node can make a developing direction feel at odds with your need for autonomy.
